body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Buffalo Technology announced the Nfiniti Wireless-N Essential Router & Access Point WHR-HP-G300N during Digital Experience at CES 2010 in Las Vegas.

An ideal solution for connecting PCs and laptops wirelessly to the Internet, it is perfectly suited for the home and small office environment. When streaming multimedia content, such as HD movies or music, the Nfiniti Essential Router lets you download images or send and receive e-mail from multiple PCs simultaneously. With speeds of up to 300Mbps it is also ideal to upgrade an existing wireless network, providing greater speed and coverage than Wireless-G.
